content: Fuzzy/typo-tolerant search (edit-distance based, e.g. Levenshtein/Damerau-Levenshtein) is a well-established search-engine technique (Algolia, Meilisearch, Typesense, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch) but is not a built-in feature of mainstream note/journal apps' tag systems (Obsidian, Bear, Apple Notes, Day One all use exact-string tag matching with plain autocomplete). No mainstream consumer journaling app was found that auto-merges near-duplicate tags into a canonical category with an 'unmatched' review bucket -- this combination is a genuine product gap this app fills.
